podcast.title: Post-Mortem Recognition
podcast.body: Delta Blues artist Robert Johnson, known primarily through myths and legends during his lifetime, saw his reputation explode in 1961, 23 years after his death, when his records were reissued. "Not when you anything about Robert Johnson when he was alive, other than some myths and legends among hardcore fans of Delta Blues, but when his records were reissued in 1961, 23 years after he died, his reputation exploded."
